description: #801, #864: an http client request's body framing, as Node 22's: after flushHeaders, a POST with no length sends Transfer-Encoding: chunked and frames each write, then 0; a GET after flushHeaders sends no framing; with headers as an array and no length, the body is chunked and its first write goes out before end(); a Transfer-Encoding: chunked in the array frames it once; with object headers too, a write() before end() makes the body chunked, in one tick or with the first chunk on the wire before end(), and end(data) alone sends a Content-Length
